chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Certainly, right is weighty and wholesome while wrong is light and epidemical.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between the nature of truth and falsehood in Shia ethics?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) contrasts the nature of truth (al-haqq) and falsehood (al-batil). Truth is described as 'weighty' (thaqil) and 'wholesome/easy to swallow' (mari'), indicating that while it may be difficult to accept or bear due to its demands, it is ultimately beneficial and pure. Falsehood is 'light' (khaf) and 'epidemical/pleasant' (bi'), suggesting it is easy to accept and appealing, but potentially widespread or superficial.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 376. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him,
said: Certainly, right is weighty and wholesome while wrong is light and epidemical.
